verses.english: “These two individuals are hard to satisfy in the world.

verses.pali: Yo ca laddhaṁ laddhaṁ nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṁ laddhaṁ vissajjeti.
verses.english: One who continually hoards wealth, and one who continually wastes wealth.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā duttappayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two individuals who are hard to satisfy in the world.”
